summary: 74-year-old woman from Chicago suffered a medical emergency aboard a tour bus on Trail Ridge Road; flown by St. Anthony Flight for Life from the west side of the park to St. Anthony Central Hospital.
location: Trail Ridge Road, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park rangers; St. Anthony Flight for Life
notes: Source: Estes Park News, "Six Incidents in Rocky Mountain National Park on Tuesday, August 14, 2012". County Grand inferred: flown from the west side of the park, with Grand Lake Fire and Grand County EMS/Ambulance assisting per the article.
